bandReport.notes: BOTH SEAMS CLEAN. p06 ends with Q58 complete (all four options are the last lines of its right column); the Directions block governing Q57-58 STARTS on p06, so band b3 owns that set and nothing is stranded across the leading seam. p09 opens with Q71, a standalone question, and no Directions block is left open at the foot of p08, so nothing straddles the trailing seam either. SIX Directions blocks, every one of which both OPENS and CLOSES inside this band, so b4 owns every member and strands none: D59-60 (pot cut from a hollow sphere, p07 left col), D61-62 (hall of length l, breadth b, height h, p07 right col), D63-64 (open box with thick sides, p07 right col), D65-66 (triangle ABC right-angled at A, p08 left col), D67-68 (annual rainfall, p08 left col), D69-70 (conical body with 120 degree vertex angle, p08 right col). Every question in this band is a set member; there is not one standalone item in b4, and all six sets are contiguous pairs. The D67-68 set crosses a COLUMN boundary inside p08 (its stimulus and Q67 sit at the foot of the left column, Q68 at the top of the right column) — a column break, not a band seam, and both members are transcribed. NO FIGURES ANYWHERE IN THIS BAND: p07 and p08 are pure two-column text, no diagram, graph, chart or printed table appears on either page, and no stem contains 'figure given below' or any equivalent — every geometry item (Q59-60 sphere/pot, Q61-62 hall diagonal, Q65-66 right triangle, Q69-70 cone) states its configuration entirely in words. hasFigure is therefore set on no question. The PDF pages carry NO TEXT LAYER at all (get_text() returns an empty string for both), so this band is pure vision; every stem, option, numeral and radical index was re-read from the source PDF at 8-9x zoom. Nothing was illegible and no glyph was ambiguous. Q68's four options are printed character-for-character identical to Q67's (40 / 400 / 4000 / 40000) — verified separately at 8x on both questions; this is what the booklet prints, not a copy-paste slip on my part, and it is internally coherent because the stimulus fixes water at 1 metric tonne per cubic metre, so the volume in cubic metres and the weight in tonnes are numerically equal. Recorded, not flagged as an error. MISPRINT FLAGGED: Q66 is printed 'What is ratio of area of triangle ADC to area of triangle ADB ?' with the article 'the' missing before 'ratio'; transcribed as printed. BOOKLET INCONSISTENCY, transcribed as printed on each side rather than harmonised: the D63-64 stimulus and Q63/Q64 spell it 'cubic metre' while the D67-68 stimulus and Q67 spell it 'cubic meter'. DECIMALS: the booklet sets a raised middle dot throughout (3.5, 4.5, 4.8, 5.0, 5.2, 5.4, 0.5, 1.850, 1.900, 2.050, 2.100); all written as ASCII full stops per the brief. INVENTED SUBTOPIC: Q67 and Q68 carry 'Volume, Density and Unit Conversion' — no listed Mensuration 3D subtopic fits a slab of rainfall over a hectare, where no named solid appears and the whole difficulty is unit conversion plus density. Faint Devanagari visible on both pages is show-through from the Hindi side of the leaf, not content.
